== Title ==
<span lang="ja">我々にもまだチャンスはある</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1 相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使う。負けた側の戦闘ダメージを3倍にする。2 「敵を過大評価しすぎだ」の結果を3倍にする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">緊急配備。デス スター接近中。15分後に、敵の射程圏内に達する。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances]].

'''Lore''' — Stand-by alert. Death Star approaching. In 15 minutes it reaches the enemy's firing range.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. 1. Use just after the opponent initiates a battle. Triple the loser's battle damage. 2. Triple the result of “You Overestimate the Enemy Too Much.”

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Option 2 names 敵を過大評価しすぎだ. English names You Overestimate Their Chances.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-dontunderestimateourchances.gif|Original English face]], [[Don't Underestimate Our Chances]].</ref>
